MonoBrowser 0.5.0

- Native content blocking in the main process powered by the Ghostery adblocker engine (uBlock/EasyList filter syntax)
- Filter lists: EasyList, EasyPrivacy, EasyList Polish, and uBlock annoyances, cached locally and refreshed automatically every 4 days
- Cosmetic filtering that hides ad elements on pages, including sandboxed views
- Global on/off switch with instant effect and a per-tab "pause blocking" action
- Blocked-request counters per tab and per session, shown in Settings and the page information menu
- Content blocking controls in the navigation menu, command palette, Settings, and the site info popup
- Command palette (`Ctrl+K`) with instant search over commands, settings, and open tabs
- Sleeping tabs: background tabs unload after 10 minutes of inactivity and wake on activation; sleeping tabs show a moon badge
- Side notes overlay with autosave to a local Markdown file and a live preview mode
- Overlay windows (find bar, palette, notes, download progress) now reliably reopen after being closed (Electron `WebContentsView` re-attach fix)
- Replaced the bundled uBlock Origin extension with the native blocking engine and removed the vendored extension files
- Added `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` with dependency and filter-list license notes

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.5.0.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.5.0-x86_64.AppImage`
